items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I made one record date that he was on.

ctx.x: He didn‟t partake of the recording scene. The first time I met him was when we were looking for a player. But he was a good player. He should have been doing some other things. He later went with Ella Fitzgerald. Was with her for a long time. Later, Jimmy Rowles had to bow out, because he couldn‟t put up with the late night things, the sessions. So Lorraine Geller came on as the piano player. She was good too. It‟s Herb‟s wife.
Some of the other – as I mentioned earlier, some of the folks who didn‟t have as strong a reputation: drummer Irv Cotler. I saw him listed on a few dates. Any recollections?

He was an older guy. I don‟t know what bands he played with, but he was an accomplished studio player, mainly, and he was Sinatra‟s favorite drummer. Sinatra insisted on him all the time. I played very seldom – I think I made one record date that he was on. But I guess he was doing a lot of work. I‟m not sure.
